Returns triggered, gapBps and the exact blazar_build_swap args to use. Never sends anything. Polygon only (chain 137).

description.description: Dry-run TWAP planner: splits a swap into N slices every intervalSeconds and compares with one swap now (impact per slice, estimated gain in bps, schedule with min-out per slice). Never sends anything; build each slice with blazar_build_swap when it is due. Polygon only (chain 137).

description.name: blazar_pools
description.description: List every BlazarSwap V2 pair on Polygon with live reserves. Use for liquidity checks or LP decisions. For a trade price use blazar_quote instead (it also covers QuickSwap and Sushi). Polygon only (chain 137).

description.name: blazar_prices
description.description: BZB/WPOL mid price and USD value on BlazarSwap, QuickSwap V2 and SushiSwap V2, with pool depth in USD from the Chainlink-backed Blazar oracle. Use for price checks and spread watching, not for a trade quote. Polygon only (chain 137).

description.name: blazar_recent_events
description.description: Read recent onchain events by log polling: BlazarFeeRouter AggregatedSwap (trader, tokens, amounts, USD) or one BlazarSwap pair's Swap + Sync (reserves and price). Returns nextFromBlock to poll again. Up to 5,000 blocks per call (about 2 hours). Polygon only (chain 137).

description.name: blazar_tokens
description.description: Uniswap-schema token list (BZB, BBY, WPOL, USDC, USDT, WETH, WBTC, M421) with addresses, decimals and transfer-tax flags. Use to resolve a symbol to an address. Polygon only (chain 137).

description.name: blazar_contracts
description.description: BlazarForce contract addresses on Polygon (router, factory, fee router, staking, daily rewards, oracle, BZB) plus the pair init code hash. Use when you need an address or ABI link; blazar_overview already includes these. Polygon only (chain 137).

description.name: blazar_staking_info
description.description: BZB single-sided staking (BlazarStakingRewards): status first (ACTIVE or REWARDS_ENDED with date), live APR from the reward rate, total staked, and optionally one account's stake, earned BZB and allowance. Use before building a stake, or to check rewards. Polygon only (chain 137).

description.name: blazar_build_stake
description.description: One call for BZB staking: ordered txs[] (exact approve if needed, then stake / withdraw / claim / exit), a summary per tx, a simulation, and warnings (e.g. REWARDS_ENDED, NOTHING_TO_CLAIM). No lock, no fee. Returns UNSIGNED txs. Polygon only (chain 137).

description.name: blazar_staking_v2_info
description.description: BlazarMultiRewardStaking (staking v2: stake BZB, earn up to 5 reward tokens, no lock). Live at 0x4222bFF08cc9D42cd3311033a4882314DfE19615. description.name: blazar_daily_rewards
description.description: BZB daily trading-rewards status for swaps through BlazarFeeRouter: today's dayId, recently posted days with totals and claim deadlines, daily cap, contract balance, and scoring rules. Use it to find a dayId before blazar_daily_claimable or blazar_build_claim. Polygon only (chain 137).

description.name: blazar_trading_rewards_preview
description.description: Preview the BZB daily trading-rewards leaderboard for a UTC day from live BlazarFeeRouter AggregatedSwap logs, using the swap-desk rules: no minimum trade, no per-wallet cap, same-wallet round trips within 10 minutes netted, top 50 listed, top 25 paid fixed shares of the daily cap. Optional account

description.name: blazar_daily_claimable
description.description: How much BZB one address can claim for one posted trading-reward day. Read-only. Get dayId from blazar_daily_rewards.postedDays. Polygon only (chain 137).

description.name: blazar_build_claim
description.description: One call to claim a posted BZB trading reward: the claim tx with a summary (amount and day), a simulation, and NOTHING_TO_CLAIM if the amount is 0. Returns an UNSIGNED tx. Polygon only (chain 137).

description.name: blazar_earn_strategies
description.description: Earning options on BlazarForce ranked from live onchain reads only (no projections): BZB staking, BlazarSwap LP positions with reserves, trading rewards, and the BZB cross-venue spread. alerts[] at the top flags ended rewards and thin liquidity. Use when the user asks how to earn with BZB or POL her

description.description: Rank BlazarForce earning options from live reads only: BZB staking, BlazarSwap LP fee APR (trailing 24h), daily trading rewards, staking v2. description.name: blazar_nft_collections
description.description: BlazarForce NFT collections on Polygon (Sleepy Validators, Night Market Stubs, Crystal Moths): live name, supply, holder count, top holders, interfaces, sample token URI, site-stated ask, marketplace links. Read-only. Polygon only (chain 137).

description.name: blazar_nft_holder
description.description: Who owns a BlazarForce NFT (tokenId), or which token ids an address holds (owner), with metadata and marketplace operator approvals. Read-only. Polygon only (chain 137).

description.name: blazar_nft_listings
description.description: Listing info for a BlazarForce NFT: owner, the site-stated ask, on-chain marketplace approvals (OpenSea Seaport conduit), and live Rarible orders only if RARIBLE_API_KEY is set in your env. There is no on-chain BlazarForce marketplace. Polygon only (chain 137).

description.name: blazar_build_nft_transfer
description.description: Build an UNSIGNED safeTransferFrom for a BlazarForce NFT after checking ownership, with a simulation and warnings (irreversible, contract recipient, burn address). the plugin's signer refuses NFT txs; sign with your own wallet. Polygon only (chain 137).

description.name: blazar_build_nft_approve
description.description: Build an UNSIGNED approve(tokenId) or setApprovalForAll (or a revoke with approved=false) for a BlazarForce NFT, with warnings for unknown operators and approve-all. the plugin's signer refuses NFT txs. Polygon only (chain 137).

description.name: blazar_deploy_templates
description.description: List the contract templates this plugin can build deploy txs for: a fixed-supply ERC-20 (no owner, no tax) and a Synthetix-style staking pool. Unaudited. Use before blazar_build_deploy. Polygon only (chain 137).

description.name: blazar_build_deploy
description.description: One call to build an UNSIGNED contract-creation tx for a template, with named parameters per template, the predicted address, a simulation (eth_call creation) and verification settings. Never deploys. Use for launching an agent token or a staking pool on Polygon. Polygon only (chain 137).

description.name: blazar_decode_tx
description.description: Decode calldata for a tx to a BlazarForce contract or an ERC-20 approve, e.g. one from another tool or agent, so you can check it before signing. Builds already include summaries, so this is for txs from other sources. Polygon only (chain 137).

description.name: blazar_simulate_tx
description.description: Dry-run any Polygon tx with eth_call + estimateGas from `from` (POL balance overridden, token balances real). Returns ok, gas, or an error code with a hint. Use for txs from other sources; builds already simulate. Polygon only (chain 137).

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "blazar_nft_listings" references sensitive artifacts (api_key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
